policy: An instrument row is a preregistered simulation experiment: declared observable, declared analysis, declared controls, and a decision rule frozen before the run, with pinned receipts. This register is a separate surface from the frozen-prediction ladder; the ladder is reserved for physical predictions against external data, and simulation instruments never enter it. Each instrument binds to exactly one observation-ledger row, and its verdict promotes or blocks that row's emergent rung. Negative and control outcomes are reported with the same prominence as positive ones. Fail closed on post-hoc analyses labeled as validation, parameters revised after data, silent reruns, omitted controls, and any run whose configuration is not reproducible from committed artifacts.

rows.title: OL-A1 (1,3) signature replication instrument
rows.decision_rule: Pointer while SPECIFIED: the binding text is the Tier A decision rule in the specification, copied verbatim into this field at freeze time. Tier A summary: arms A1 = 16384/128/96, A2 = 65536/256/96, and C1 = 16384/128/6 with five declared replicates per arm; observables O1 threshold inertia, O2 robust inertia at relative tau 1e-3 with reference (1,2)/(1,2)/(2,1), O3 degeneracy ratio against the reference band 2e-5..4e-5, O4 cone margin and rung ratio (retained 0.5725, declared band 0.35..0.80), O5 structural diagnostics, and O6 split-half inertia concordance; verdict REPLICATED, FAILED, or INCONCLUSIVE per the frozen rule, and FAILED demotes the OL-A1 emergent rung with equal prominence. Eigenvalue caution: the archived (1,3) threshold verdict rides on one eigenvalue at relative magnitude about 3e-5 against a 1e-12 threshold; at a relative threshold of 1e-3 the robust inertia of the retained rungs is (1,2) with one degenerate direction, matching the independently measured (1,2) receipt, and a fresh seed can flip (1,3) to (2,2) with no change in physical content. Every public sentence about this instrument carries that caution.
rows.seeds_policy: One fresh seed drawn at freeze time and five declared replicate ids per arm. The held-out split is stride-structured per rung (strides 8/35/141), so train/held-out parity structure is recorded and stratified across replicates. N = 5 resolves seed fragility at the 1-in-5 level only, and the report states so. The runtime environment is single and recorded.
controls: C-SUPPORT: matched support-density control at 16384/128/6; a fired control reads as mean signature degradation plus halved cross edges.
C-ANCESTRY: ancestry-permutation null at zero extra runtime; the null destroys (1,3) on at least 4 of 5 replicates.
